Once a serene paradise boasting beautiful natural landscapes, Island is now a desolate ruin unrecognizable from it's past. Originally known for its lush forests and pristine beaches, the island’s fate changed when EDEN established its roots there. Deep beneath the island, EDEN constructed a secret base to experiment with 'Dark Trinitium', a legendary energy source believed to be magnitudes more powerful than it's predecessor, granting unlimited power to those who are able to harness it's full potential. 

Amidst the chaos of rampant AI and aging electric power systems, the world faced a severe energy crisis. Seizing this opportunity, EDEN aimed to secretly produce Dark Trinitium to reshape the world, but in a bid to thwart EDEN's ambitions, the NAF stepped in, determined to halt their plans.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/38e2a580ea7e77931432898b6fbcad362234687e.png

Hello everyone, this is the Ironsight team.

This update introduces one of the features that have been frequently requested by the community recently.

Until now, during matchmaking, the server has been selected automatically to ensure the lowest possible ping for the majority of players in the lobby. Unfortunately however, this sometimes forces an outlying user to play on a server that is suboptimal. Although there may be more suitable servers available, a user can be forced into high ping servers if the pool of users available is concentrated in a specific region.

There have been many requests to divide the SEA and Asia regions, but before the merging of the servers last year in July, there were a lot of reports regarding long queue times and issues with matchmaking. As such, it has been judged that re-dividing the regions would not be feasible with the current number of users.

Alternatively, in order to help alleviate the issue we have decided to provide users the option to select which servers to connect to when matchmaking. As long as the user pool is sufficient, this will allow users to play on the servers that provide the best experience for them.

There are some concerns that this may reduce the number of possible users in the matchmaking pool, but we hope it will improve the overall game experience for all users.

In addition to this weeks maintenance, a special event will also be held this weekend, so continue reading to learn more about the new matchmaking options, special event, and the closing of Season 9!

Hello everyone, this is the Ironsight Team.

The in-game voice chat function will be added with the February 10th Update. Use the brand new voice chat feature with your team and party members to gain the upper hand and come out victorious.

In a situation where you have to fight tooth and nail, clear and effective communication can be the determining factor in winning by enhancing the team's unity.

Voice chat will also serve as a laid back communication channel where you can enjoy the casual atmosphere with your friends and team mates and have some fun!

It will also allow you to pass on tips to newer members, teaching them some of the things you have learnt through your experiences.

As there have been many requests from the community for a voice chat feature, we expect that it will be utilized a lot for a variety of different activities and situations!

Please make sure to disconnect from the servers in advance in order to avoid any issues.

Time:
[KST] 14:00 ~ 15:00 February 10th
[CET] 08:00 ~ 09:00 February 10th
[PDT] 21:00 ~ 22:00 February 9th




Voice Chat Manual
Voice chat is divided into two channels, party chat and in-game team chat.

The Party Voice Chat channel is created as soon as a party is created, and players that join the party will instantly join the Party Voice Chat channel.

The Team Voice Chat channel is joined upon entering a game, and is restricted to push to talk only.

FFA game modes such as Battle Royale and Gun Game use proximity chat, with directional audio and dynamic volume depending on the distance between players (with a maximum difference of around 15-20 meters)

If a custom match is joined as a party, the party voice chat will persist even if party members are on different teams.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/c3d10cb20a52a44495113a0b3e9a78db6d82bb6d.png
Find the Voice Chat settings by going to Settings > Audio > Voice Chat 

Voice Chat : Enable/Disable the Voice Chat feature entirely
   Echo Test Use this option in order to listen to and check your current mic settings.
Party Voice Chat : Enable/Disable Party Voice Chat 
Party Voice Activation Mode : Choose between Automatic or Push to Talk for Party Voice Chat.
Team Voice Chat : Enable/Disable Team Voice Chat.
    Note: Team Voice Chat is restricted to Push to Talk only.
Output Device  : Select the device to listen the Voice Chat.
Input Device : Select the device to speak on the Voice Chat.
Incoming Volume  : Output sound level of Voice Chat. 
Mic Volume : The output volume of your microphone.
Mic Sensitivity : How sensitive your mic is when using automatic voice activation.

Keybind Settings
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/d56211371bf6c712ac7b818b4ed5b04691c40193.png
Adjust your voice chat key-binds in the Settings > Controls > Community tab

Player Board : Mute and report players individually. Default (P)
Party Voice Chat : Default (U) 
Team Voice Chat : Default (V) 
The bomb/flag drop key has been changed to (H). Keyboard settings may have to be reset or manually changed.

Player Board (In-game)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/d70af60222425b27e61c333e2b33291bf1b4b874.png
Whilst in a match, press the (P) key to open up the Player Board. On this screen you can mute other players individually by clicking the speaker icon next to their name, or mute your on microphone on the fly by clicking the microphone icon next to your name.

You can also use this screen to report any of the users in the match for chat abuse, cheating, bug abuse, etc.

Muting a player only mutes them in the current Team Voice Chat channel.

Currently Mute only applies to team voice chat

Voice Activity Display
See who is currently talking on the left hand side of the screen. This display will show who is talking in party and team voice chat. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/bb79068702eda84081afd37c4f8460ec213b085a.png

You can also see who is currently talking on the scoreboard screen by pressing tab.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/bc7b7a1d9505885645abeb09f57b0b15d4964142.png


Note
Device Settings

If the device is not displayed in the list, please install the latest drivers and check again.
When changing the microphone or headset device, if the menu screen does not update you may need to close and re-open the menu in order for it to display the correct option.

Game Policy Update

Receiving a mute in-game mutes your voice as well as your text chat regardless of which form you used to break the games policy.

New special mode in Ironsight, Team Battle Royal!

Team Battle Royal
Objective : Eliminate all the enemies avoiding magnetic field.
Victory condition : Win 3 matches
Numbers of player : 4 to 12 players
Maps : Mart, Cruise, Haruyama
*Caution : The weapon EXP cannot be gained from Team Battle Royal Mode.


Match Flow
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/4bff889c054b173881363c9e1cb1f331c386b852.jpg
1. Players start with the main weapon and secondary weapon in the loadout. Only one ammo is provided for main weapon.
2. On the field, the ammo, ammo box, throwing weapons, syringe, healing grenade and etc are dropped randomly.
3. The farming bot is spawned in the middle of the map, and if it is destroyed, one of the drones will be available for looting.
4. The magnetic field will zoom in to the area which is shown on the minimap after 15 seconds standby time.
5. total 5 times of zooming in will proceed, and during the standby time, the area of zooming in and location will be marked.
6. Player HP regeneration will not be available, and if HP reaches 0, the player will turn into groggy status.
7. The player who is in groggy, they can be revived by the teammates with 'revive' function.
8. The team who stands in the end wins the round!

Components
Magnetic Field
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/ab15dc4c1f03c095ebc3fec30ef612cce4220c6d.jpg
New magnetic fields are being spawned each round.
The magnetic fields will have total 5 times of zoom in and each time, it has 15 seconds of standby time.
If you enter the magnetic field area, you will receive 5 damage per second, and as long as it reaches to next magnetic field, the damage multiplies by 1.2 from former area damage.

Groggy status
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/9a52e960b289fc38b5f21037f4d51518c7cdb5a4.jpg
When player's HP reaches to 0, it will turn into groggy status.
The groggy player's view will turn to 3rd person's view.
Groggy player can slowly move around, be damaged by enemy players.
Groggy player can be revived by teammates.
- Player will revive with 30 HP.
If you are damaged by explosives(Drone, throwing weapons, and red can), you will be retired immediately without any groggy status.

Farming Bot
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/98527d56ecfb0ef0820b3a8cdc4f96ced1408aa8.jpg
Farming bot will be spawned in each center of the maps.
If you destroy farming bot, randomly, nothing will come out or one drone will come out.
if you get drone box, you should fill the point to use the drone. The points are differ to drones.
If you are killed, your weapons and drones will be dropped.
When the round is turned, you can still use the drones you got from former round.
Drone will be removed when you use it one time.



Drop items
Drop items will be dropped on the field as following.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/187b78a7eadee7fbc84e74080eff04db5bc3b309.jpg


Syringe
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/b07758e7a4eb28febff4d069b5c8cff04525d153.jpg
Total 50HP will be recovered during 3 seconds after use.
You can cancel the motion to other while you use.
Total 2 syringe can be kept.

Healing grenade
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/61e08cf53b4553899c93929b8031b86c69b153a2.jpg
Healing 'all players' by 10 HP per sec for 15 seconds in 3M.

Ammo, Ammo Box
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/d0777ee184383a748b709725a56a9a0ad38bc71d.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35212832/a9939191286ed11213b9bb82bbeb6b26a65a9747.jpg
